publishedDiagnosticScripts.reason: Standalone audit scripts added after engine validation; exercised directly on final snapshots. Production dist unchanged.

normalMatrix.sanitization: Whitelist of public corpus labels and metric fields; no source text, file paths, commands, raw diagnostics or queries copied.

methodology.campaignFiles: Only baseline/candidate-final, the six public corpus labels, repetitions 1–3; old candidate, supplemental and profile checkpoints are excluded.
methodology.revisions: Process sourceSha/revision identifies the corpus, not the engine. Frozen engine revisions/digests are supplied by engine-hashes.json; checkpoint engine identity is validated, without rehashing engine files.
methodology.distributions: Median/min/max of fully completed non-profile verification runs; all failed/capped/incomplete attempts retained separately.
methodology.processTime: report.elapsedMs only; scheduler durations deliberately ignored for every run.
methodology.noChange: Median within each run, then median/min/max across those per-run medians.
methodology.graphEquality: Full semantic node SHA-256, complete edge SHA-256, and counts; fewer than two runs cannot establish repeatability.
methodology.flowCounts: Actual returned explore Flow presence/parsed steps only; no completeness claim and no substitution of internal graph paths.
methodology.databaseSize: Before-close snapshots only; no filesystem or SQLite reads performed by this aggregator.

normalFlowDetails.scope: Historical normal-matrix prompts; a surfaced Flow is distinct from internal named paths and from proven end-to-end coverage. Retained-Flow truncation is measured; full-response truncation was not recorded by this harness. No observations is not a negative result. Supplemental/diagnostic probes are separate.

ghcFirstAttemptStatus.methodology: Capped checkpoints are reported separately and never treated as completed timings.

diagnosticCpu.methodology: V8 time-delta-weighted samples of the profiled main thread. Includes idle/runtime time; worker CPU is absent. Inclusive functions count recursion once per sample. Profiled runs are diagnostic, separate from benchmark timing runs. Compare function/file identity; compiled line numbers can shift between builds.

hostileScaling.methodology: Three isolated children per input size and engine; benchmark script configures a 256 MiB heap cap and 3000 ms process timeout. Operation duration excludes startup. No timed-out, failed or incomplete sample is used in completed-operation distributions; statuses and raw samples remain explicit. This script only reads existing JSON.

exactGraphReview.methodology: Exact semantic comparison on inactive DB/WAL copies; every differing edge identity enumerated. Matching prior reviewed edge identity, metadata and provenance permits reuse of prior pinned-source evidence; new differences require readonly ToolHandler context before narrow source review. Graph counts alone do not validate retrieval completeness.

xmonad.methodology: Exact full semantic projections: all node columns except updated_at; edges exclude surrogate id. Every added/removed identity and every modified same-identity row is listed. Edge identity is source,target,kind,IFNULL(line,-1),IFNULL(col,-1). Source-location groups do not assert one-to-one retargeting or correctness. Metadata fields outside a small public identity whitelist and source-bearing node fields retain comparison hashes only. No corpus source was read. No integrity/page scan is run here.

reviewedPublicAdditions.scope: Added edges only; removed HLS kick calls are handled in a separate investigation.
reviewedPublicAdditions.method: Reviewed actual readonly ToolHandler explore source responses first, then bounded source reads only for omitted code. Compared source tokens and import/export routes for every added edge; no corpus compilation performed.

entries.sourceEvidence: Bounded source fallback for omitted line

pandoc.explanation: All 33 edges target Content.Text in Text.Pandoc.XML.Light.Types (Content(..) export). XML.Light reexports that module. Each external use imports XML.Light or Types, including EndNote via Content(..); the three uses in Types are local. Data.Text (Text) contributes only a type, so it is not a competing value constructor. There are 26 references, five ordinary constructor applications and two existing heuristic combinator calls via map and $.

hls.explanation: Five references use the bidirectional GhcSessionDeps pattern as a rule key; RuleTypes exports it bundled with its type and Development.IDE reexports RuleTypes. Rename imports RuleTypes directly for the GetParsedModule constructor and Shake hiding (Log) for the ShakeExtras record pattern; Shake exports ShakeExtras(..). All seven are value references, not type references.

limits: Static source/import/export review, not compilation of the Pandoc or HLS package graph.
The two Pandoc map/$ calls retain heuristic provenance; their targets are valid, but runtime execution is not established.
No conclusion here about removed HLS kick edges, overall graph completeness, or agent A/B sufficiency.

ghcDiagnostics.scope: Existing baseline evidence and two newly preserved final-candidate GHC snapshots. No previous-candidate evidence is presented as final.
ghcDiagnostics.semanticParity: Not established by these diagnostics. Partial counts, progress and absent Flow do not establish complete-index parity or resolution-quality gains.
ghcDiagnostics.identitySource: Explicit frozen-engine identity supplied by the root task; these diagnostic scripts do not rebuild or hash engines.

method.opening: Isolated DB plus WAL copy, native SQLite readOnly and query_only; no lifecycle open, heal, index, sync, checkpoint, or vacuum.
method.timeInterpretation: Diagnostic times only. Other validation could run concurrently; these durations are not performance comparisons.
method.baselineReuse: Already collected baseline public evidence only; baseline databases are not reopened.
method.probes: Six serial candidate-final probes: two actual Flow, two fresh resolver traces, two storage-health probes.
method.originalProtection: Existing bounded helpers copy DB plus WAL, open only the copy readOnly/query_only, and compare original hashes, sizes and mtimes before/after.

orphans.caveat: Missing node endpoints are integrity defects; node/file record mismatches need interpretation (synthetic nodes, skipped files, interrupted stores), not automatic semantic-failure labels.

pageStorage.meaning: Logical committed pages including copied WAL; physical DB+WAL sizes are reported separately. No checkpoint/VACUUM performed.
